verdict.rationale: Appwrite's CLI explicitly documents non-interactive/headless usage 'without saving configuration or sessions... especially useful when you want to automate tasks on a continuous integration server' (appwrite-docs-42), and self-hosting via Docker plus the CLI's ability to manage projects, functions, and resources supports full automation/CI pipelines (appwrite-docs-12, appwrite-docs-14, appwrite-docs-22). missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of CI usage in practice, and no example CI config/pipeline snippet provided.
